name: Translated Letter
summary: In Darkshire, Sirra Von'Indi translates Abercrombie's letter for Mayor Ello Ebonlocke. The message reveals what the hermit made with the supplies brought to him.

sections.title: A Gruesome Revelation
sections.body: The errands began as acts of mercy for a seemingly helpless hermit in Raven Hill. Abercrombie's obscure message to Mayor Ello Ebonlocke remained a mystery until Sirra Von'Indi translated it. The words reveal that the hermit is the Embalmer. He used the supplies brought to him to build Stitches, a monstrous abomination, then unleashed the hulking creation on Darkshire's people to trample and slaughter them.

sections.title: The Price of Good Intentions
sections.body: When the translated message is presented to Lord Ello Ebonlocke, the mayor's face drains of color. The traveler's help came from goodwill, but Abercrombie used that labor to build an instrument of slaughter. As the town council scrambles to marshal the Night Watch, the letter reveals how charity can be twisted into devastation on Duskwood's haunted roads.

faq.q: What does the Translated Letter say?
faq.answer: The letter carries an alarming message from Abercrombie to Lord Ello Ebonlocke. Its full contents are revealed when you deliver the translated note to him in Darkshire.
Sirra Von'Indi, a scholar in Darkshire, translates Abercrombie's cryptic handwriting and warns you to hurry back to Lord Ello with the alarming news.

faq.q: What happens when Ello reads the letter?
faq.answer: Ello is deeply alarmed by the translation. Bring the letter to him to learn what it means for Darkshire.

faq.q: Can I throw away the Translated Letter after the quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Once Lord Ello inspects the parchment and advances the town's defense, the letter remains in your pack as a souvenir and has no further use.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler in Duskwood, you learn how good intentions can be turned against Darkshire's fragile defenders.
